component.name: Figma Font Agent
component.summary: Use your installed fonts in Figma for the web

description.p: Figma can use the fonts installed on your computer, but the helper that makes them available is only published for macOS and Windows. Figma Font Agent is an independent, open-source implementation of that helper for Linux: while it runs, the browser version of Figma can list, preview and use your local fonts.
The agent has no window. It listens on this computer only, answers requests from figma.com only, and has no telemetry and no updater.
This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Figma, Inc.
